info.name: PhotoLine
info.summary: A fast, scrollable timeline of your photos and videos
info.description:
PhotoLine shows the photos and videos of any folder, or of a set of folders you choose, as one fast timeline grouped by day, with a year and month scrubber for jumping through the years.
**Features**
- One timeline for the folders you select ("My timeline"), with duplicates shown once - A timeline of any folder, opened from a button in the Files app - Year and month scrubber, filters for photos or videos and for a date range - Full-screen view with keyboard and swipe navigation - Thumbnails are prepared in the background, so browsing never waits for image processing - Video thumbnails made with ffmpeg when the server has it, otherwise from the first frame shown when a video is played - View only: the app never changes, uploads or shares files
Thumbnails are built by ownCloud's background jobs (cron mode recommended). The first run on a large library can take a while; `occ photoline:thumbnails` can be used to run it manually.
